name: Highway to Hell-th
source: Leon H. Kidman is 18, fresh out of high school, and preparing to start life beyond... or so they would be, had they not just cut off their father. With the guilt and shame of this choice lurking in the rear-view mirror and an unwanted life advisor suddenly appearing in the passenger seat, his roadtrip home for the summer is thrown for a loop.
